titleJa: ソケットレンチのハンドルと交換ソケット
captionJa: ソケットを取り付けたハンドルと、交換用ソケットの形を見比べます。
altJa: 銀色のラチェットハンドルにソケットが一つ付いています。横に大きさの異なる円筒形の交換ソケットが三つ並び、先端のくぼみが見えます。
limitsJa: 形と部品の組合せを学ぶための例示です。ソケットの規格・寸法・内部形状の厳密さ、全製品の外観、安全な締付け力や作業手順を保証しません。
mode: built-in image_gen single call; original text-only generation
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original tool-recognition illustration for a Japanese agriculture learning app. Create one square educational 2D colored realistic illustration on a warm off-white background. Subject: a socket wrench set, consisting of one complete silver steel ratchet handle with one cylindrical detachable socket attached at its head, plus three separate cylindrical interchangeable sockets of different sizes laid beside it. Show the full handle and all sockets, no cropping. Use an oblique three-quarter view that clearly shows the sockets' hollow six-point hexagonal openings and the mechanical distinction between a handle and interchangeable socket. Keep believable simple tool construction, crisp dark contours, restrained soft painted shading and readable forms, consistent with a clean colored technical textbook illustration rather than a photograph or glossy 3D render. Diagonal balanced composition, ample empty margins on every side. No wrench in use, no bolts, no hands, no people, no arrows, no labels, no text, no numbers, no dimensions, no logos, no watermark. No decorative objects, no copied photograph or page layout.

authorVisualInspection.assessment: Suitable candidate for tool recognition and interchangeable-part comparison; independent peer review and runtime display testing still required. Exact socket opening count/profile is not certified.
